resolvedQuestions.question: List the eight hard rule ids declared in .opencode/skills/cli-external-orchestration/cli-hermes/SKILL.md and state which one a fan-out lineage exercises by construction, citing the file and line for each id.
resolvedQuestions.answer: The eight hard rule ids are stdin-redirect-required (SKILL.md:7), hermes-availability-required (SKILL.md:11), yolo-required-for-writes (SKILL.md:15), ignore-rules-required (SKILL.md:19), explicit-toolsets-required (SKILL.md:23), no-worktree-flag (SKILL.md:27), mcp-config-operator-required (SKILL.md:31), hooks-user-level (SKILL.md:35). The rule a fan-out lineage exercises by construction is stdin-redirect-required (SKILL.md:7): the lineage dispatch is non-interactive by construction and buildHermesLineageCommand emits chat -Q --oneshot --query-file - with the prompt on stdin.

keyFindings.summary: stdin-redirect-required (l.7), hermes-availability-required (l.11), yolo-required-for-writes (l.15), ignore-rules-required (l.19), explicit-toolsets-required (l.23), no-worktree-flag (l.27), mcp-config-operator-required (l.31), hooks-user-level (l.35)

keyFindings.label: A fan-out lineage exercises stdin-redirect-required by construction
keyFindings.summary: Non-interactive dispatch is inherent to a lineage; buildHermesLineageCommand emits --query-file - with the prompt on stdin, satisfying the rule's MUST

keyFindings.label: Adjunct structural rules are conditional, not by-construction
keyFindings.summary: yolo-required-for-writes binds only write leaves; no-worktree-flag is enforced by the containment guard on violation; hermes-availability-required is a pre-dispatch probe
